name: payload_stage
description: Stage one hash-qualified ELF through ps4debug-NG CMD_PROC_ELF_RPC after exact target identity, executable-text, fingerprint and pointer verification. Resolves payload_rpc_entry without calling the raw image entry, rejects duplicate residency, reuses one RPC stub per PID, and waits for a ready heartbeat. Never retries an uncertain upload.

payload.description: ELF artifact containing an exported payload_rpc_entry

name: payload_recover
description: Revalidate the exact target, find one payload_rpc_entry signature in bounded anonymous executable mappings, reuse/install the RPC stub, and verify payload status. Does not upload another ELF.

name: payload_status
description: Call command 0 on a staged/recovered payload after checking process identity and the resident RPC signature. Returns validated lifecycle, initialization stage and heartbeat.

name: payload_rpc
description: Invoke a bounded numeric command on the already staged/recovered payload RPC entry, never an arbitrary address. RPC implementations must be atomic and non-blocking. Commands 0 and 2 additionally validate the status response.

name: payload_shutdown
description: Request payload RPC command 2. The runtime disables features and removes owned hooks on its own thread; the image may intentionally remain resident and inert if restoration fails. This is not an ELF unload.
